content: Cefamandole, marketed under the brand name Mandol® (Cefamandole Nafate for Injection, USP), is a semi-synthetic, broad-spectrum cephalosporin antibiotic designed for parenteral administration. Its chemical structure is classified as 5-thia-1-azabicyclo[4.2.0]oct-2-ene-2-carboxylic acid, 7-amino-3-methyl-8-oxo-, monosodium salt. Mandol contains 63 mg of sodium carbonate per gram of cefamandole activity, which corresponds to 3 milliequivalents (mEq) of sodium ions per gram of cefamandole activity. Upon the addition of a diluent, cefamandole nafate undergoes rapid hydrolysis to form cefamandole, and both compounds exhibit microbiological activity in vivo. The solutions of Mandol vary in color from light yellow to amber, depending on the concentration and the type of diluent used.
